title: Brand Spotlight: Gisada, the Swiss House Behind Long-Lasting Cologne

body_markdown:
Some fragrance houses chase trends.[Gisada](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/gisada) chases staying power, literally. Founded in Zurich in 2013 by two brothers with a shared obsession for perfumery, the Swiss brand has built a reputation across more than 90 countries on a simple premise: fragrances with real longevity, thanks to a higher oil concentration than most brands bother with. Every elegant Gisada release is built around a story, designed to actually last through the day.


If you’re looking for a long-lasting cologne that doesn’t sacrifice complexity for staying power, here’s a closer look at three of the brand’s standout men’s fragrances.


## [GISADA Ambassador Men](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/gisada-ambassador-men-4343)


Green mandarin and apple open things up juicy and bright, sharpened by cardamom and a touch of violet. Lavender, black pepper, and peony fill out the heart, with patchouli and mango adding an unexpected exotic edge. The base settles into vetiver, amber, and vanilla, grounded by moss and teak. It’s a genuinely layered scent, fresh and spicy up top, sophisticated and earthy by the finish.


## [GISADA Gold](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/gisada-gold-127307053091051)


Ginger, bergamot, and cardamom open sharp and energetic, with pepper and lemon adding brightness. Sage, lavender, and vetiver take over through the middle, rounded out by geranium, cypress, and rose for real depth. Ambroxan, cedar, oakmoss, and labdanum settle it into a warm, woody base. Launched in 2025, it’s built to feel fresh and warm at once, versatile enough for daily wear without sacrificing complexity.


## [GISADA Titanium](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/gisada-titanium-75913932892995)


Cardamom, sage, and pink pepper open with real energy, joined by artemisia for a slightly green, herbal edge. Lavender, sandalwood, cinnamon, and leather fill out a heart that’s warm and a little rugged, before vanilla, tonka bean, iris, patchouli, and balsam fir settle into a rich, ambery base. Created by perfumers Olaf Larsen and Lucas Sieuzac and launched in 2024, it’s the boldest of the three, built for a wearer who wants a fragrance with real confidence behind it.


## **Try Gisada for a long-lasting cologne**


Gisada’s whole reputation rests on how a fragrance performs hours after you’ve put it on. A[Scentbird subscription](https://www.scentbird.com/) lets you actually test that for yourself: an 8 ml vial of Ambassador Men, Gold, or Titanium gives you real, all-day wear to judge before deciding which one earns a permanent spot in your rotation.
